title: My week in one paragraph
objective: Rédiger un paragraphe organisé sur son quotidien

steps.title: Warm-up: my busiest day
steps.student_instruction: Tell a partner your busiest day of the week and three things you do.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Réactiver routines et jours ; noter au tableau les verbes de routine utiles pour l'écrit.

steps.title: Listening: Using colours to do homework
steps.student_instruction: Listen to a student explain her homework system. Note the order of her steps.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire écouter l'audio British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours. Faire repérer comment elle organise son explication : c'est le modèle d'organisation du paragraphe.

steps.title: Language focus: linking words
steps.student_instruction: Sort the linking words: order, addition, contrast, reason.
steps.facilitator_instruction: first/then/after that/finally ; and/also ; but ; because. Montrer la structure phrase d'introduction - développement - conclusion.

steps.title: Differentiated writing
steps.student_instruction: Write your paragraph with your A, B or C sheet.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : paragraphe à trous guidé ; B : plan puis 70 mots ; C : 100 mots avec opinion et contraste. Corriger au crayon en signalant, sans réécrire.

steps.title: Peer review with colours
steps.student_instruction: Swap paragraphs. Colour the linking words and check: topic sentence, order, conclusion.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Fournir une grille de relecture ; observer la qualité des remarques entre pairs. Chaque élève améliore deux phrases.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write your best sentence with two linking words.

sheets.student_content: Complete the paragraph with First, Then, After that, Finally, because: My Mondays are busy. ___, I get up at seven. ___, I go to school by bus. ___, I do my homework. ___, I watch a series ___ I like relaxing.
sheets.facilitator_correction: First, Then, After that, Finally, because.

sheets.student_content: Make a plan (topic sentence, three activities, conclusion), then write a 70-word paragraph about your week with four linking words.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple : My week is busy but fun. First, I go to school by bus. Then I do my homework. After that, I play basketball on Wednesdays because I love team sports. Finally, I relax at the weekend.

sheets.student_content: Write 100 words about your ideal week compared with your real week. Use but, whereas, because and a conclusion.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : organisation claire, connecteurs variés et justes, conclusion personnelle.

criteria: L'élève utilise au moins quatre connecteurs justes

common_errors: Oubli de la majuscule après le point
